workload.note: Missed games early season (hamstring) and midseason (ankle, concussions); listed WR2 behind Ja'Marr Chase.

contract.note: 4-year deal replacing a franchise tender worth $26.16M. 2026 terms: $10M fully-guaranteed offseason roster bonus, $10.9M guaranteed base salary, $100K workout bonus, plus $2M in per-game roster bonuses (up to $8M tied to weekly availability). Incentives: $1M for 65%+ snap share + AFC title; $1.7M if Bengals win Super Bowl. Signals team views him as a true co-No.1, not a No.2 role player.

scheme.note: No OC change — Pitcher continues in 2026 (promoted to OC in 2024), per wcpo.com/spectrumnews1 (2026-07-27/28): stated 2026 goals are 'more explosive plays and fewer turnovers.'

competition.name: Ja'Marr Chase
competition.note: Bengals' top target; Higgins and Chase combined for 12,278 yards, 99 TD in their careers per atozsports.com (2026-06-24).

competition.name: Andrei Iosivas
competition.note: Depth behind Chase/Higgins per atozsports.com depth chart preview (2026-06-24).

notes: atozsports.com (2026-06-24): Higgins described as 'an undisputed No. 1 option for about half the league if he were anywhere else' — signals locked-in WR2 role only because Chase is ahead of him, not a competition/decline story.
